stories.title: Council steps in to bridge joint archive’s £1.2m shortfall
stories.summary: A £1.2m funding shortfall in the joint Flintshire and Denbighshire archive project is not expected to hold up the plans after Flintshire agreed to provide an additional £170,000. stories.title: “Totally unacceptable” that Rhuallt and Tremeirchion water supply problems persist
stories.summary: Residents in two Denbighshire villages have complained of persistent water supply problems following a series of bursts to a water main.
